scenes.headline: How FAR-LIO keeps odometry locked at speed
scenes.sub: A CUDA scan pipeline and a tiny delay-compensating filter, built for 250 km/h racing.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Odessa! Keeping a race car's pose locked at two hundred fifty kilometres an hour means rethinking where the work happens.

scenes.text: Move the whole geometry onto the GPU, keep a tiny delay-compensating filter on the CPU, and one parameter set holds from a city street to a racetrack.
scenes.say: Move the heavy geometry onto the GPU, keep a small filter on the processor, and one parameter set holds from a city street to a racetrack.

scenes.title: One scan, scan pipeline to pose

steps.say: A laser scan arrives. The map is a flat hash table on the GPU, so thousands of threads search it at once with no tree to walk.
A sparsity-aware matcher aligns the scan to the map, and keeps the sparse far points a strict version would throw away.
The aligned pose drops to a small Kalman filter that fuses it with the inertial sensor a hundred times a second.

steps.note: the pose is fed back as the next scan's guess
steps.say: It projects the slightly old pose forward to now, streams a smooth result, and the scan joins the map.

scenes.title: Compensating the pipeline's own delay
scenes.say: The registered pose is already a few milliseconds old when it lands.

parts.note: how much the state moved since
parts.say: So the filter adds how much its own estimate moved in between, and corrects to the present instead of the past.

scenes.title: Racing error, Yas Marina
scenes.note: lower is better; KISS-ICP had no valid result
scenes.say: On the hardest racetrack the error drops to about fifteen and a half metres, well under every baseline that even finished.

scenes.label: per racing scan, on about 20% of one GPU
scenes.note: far below the 60 to 100 ms where odometry diverges
scenes.say: And it does it in about nineteen milliseconds a scan, far below the delay where the racing estimate starts to diverge.

scenes.text: FAR-LIO moves the geometry onto the GPU and leaves a tiny delay-compensating filter on the CPU — one config, street to racetrack.

recap: A GPU voxel map and sparsity-aware match
scenes.say: To recap: a GPU voxel map, a sparsity-aware matcher, and a tiny delay-compensating filter. One parameter set, two hundred fifty kilometres an hour.
